title: 第7章 逆天北美高中第8章 上东区兼职见闻
slug: 人在美利坚我的叔叔堂吉诃德
content_zh:
“你们美利坚把这叫高中？”李维指着车窗外的景色，扭过头来看着抽烟的堂吉诃德，“不说我还以为是什么军事基地呢。”
在李维对于美利坚高中有限的记忆中，美利坚的高中应该都像《歌舞青春》或者《绯闻女孩》那样，是绿草如茵、红砖白瓦的开放式校园。
但是现在，摆在他面前的是被三米高的铁丝网死死围住的混凝土堡垒。铁丝网的顶端向内卷曲，看上去是为了防止有人翻进去——或者翻出来。
除了校门口那个摇摇欲坠的“富兰克林·k·莱恩高中”的牌子之外，最显眼的就是那两辆停在路边的PD（纽约警察局）的警车。
“但是你现在这个情况也只能上这个了，”堂吉诃德吐出了一口烟圈，把烟蒂随手往窗外一弹，拍了拍李维的肩膀，“走吧，这个地方就跟臭狗屎一样，我可不想在这里长待。”
两人下了车，走向正门。
如果说外观像监狱，那进门的流程就更像了。
此时正是上学的时间点，门口排起了长龙。李维走近一看，才发现原来所有人都在过安检。
“滴——！”
前排一个留着脏辫的黑人女生被拦了下来。
“把包打开！”一名体型硕大的安保吼道，“你知道规矩的，塔妮莎！”
“法克！我只是带了个卷发棒！”那个叫塔妮莎的女生一边骂骂咧咧，一边不情愿地把包里的东西倒在桌子上，其中就有一把做工粗糙的折叠梳子。
“你这是什么？”安保拿起梳子看了看，直接扔进了垃圾桶，“尖头太锋利，没收。”
“那是我的梳子，你这个臭婊子——”
“下一个！”
经过简单的登记之后，两人被放行进了教学楼。
刚一进走廊，一股混着叶子味道、陈旧的拖把馊味和廉价的古龙水的香味就直冲天灵盖。
走廊两侧的储物柜大半都凹陷了进去，上面覆盖着层层叠叠的涂鸦。天花板上的灯管坏了一半，另外一半正有气无力的闪烁着，发出令人烦躁的滋滋声。
“我说，你们美利坚校园里是种叶子的吗？”李维看着四周看向他的好奇目光，“这个高中我是非上不可吗？”
周围的目光中好奇又带着惊艳，大部分的目光来自一些拉美裔和黑人裔的女生——这两个群体的学生占据了学校族裔的主流，还有一小部分的目光是由不怀好意的男生发出的。

他们说着带着口音的西班牙语或者是混杂着俚语的街头话，对着李维和堂吉诃德指指点点，时不时发出一阵大笑声。
“没办法，”堂吉诃德嘟哝了一声，“纽约州的法律就是这么规定的。”
两人七拐八拐，终于在一楼的角落里面找到了行政办公室。
推门进去，李维更是对‘美利坚教育系统’完蛋了有了更深刻的理解。
办公桌上面堆满了没处理的文件箱，甚至还有半个吃剩下的披萨盒子。负责接待的是一个看起来刚睡醒的中年白人女性，她的四层下巴被一条极细的项链勒了出来，她的两瓣儿屁股看上去有星球那么大。
“干什么？”
她的眼皮都没抬，依旧盯着电脑屏幕上的糖果粉碎消除游戏。
“我是堂吉诃德·塞万提斯......这位......帕尔默女士，这是我的侄子李维，刚刚来到纽约不久，”堂吉诃德递上了准备好的文件，“我是来给他办转学的。”
帕尔默女士慢吞吞地接过，一边像树懒一样敲击着键盘，一边嘟囔着：“布鲁克林.......外国人......没有过往的成绩记录。拿着吧，这是你的课表，1个月后开学。”
打印机发出了一阵像是要散架的惨叫。
她竟是问也不问李维要上什么课，就把李维的课表给打了出来。
content_en:
"You Americans call this high school?" Levi pointed to the scenery outside the car window and turned to look at Don Quixote, who was smoking. "If you didn't tell me, I would have thought it was some kind of military base."
In Levi's limited memory of American high schools, American high schools should be like "High School Musical" or "Gossip Girl", which are open campuses with green grass and red bricks and white tiles.
But now, what stood before him was a concrete fortress surrounded by a three-meter-high barbed wire fence. The top of the wire fence is curled inwards, seemingly to prevent someone from climbing in - or flipping out.
Apart from the crumbling "Franklin K. Lane High School" sign at the school gate, the most conspicuous thing was the two PD (New York Police Department) police cars parked on the roadside.
"But this is the only way you can end up in this situation," Don Quixote blew out a smoke ring, flicked the cigarette butt out of the window, and patted Levi on the shoulder, "Let's go, this place is like stinking shit, and I don't want to stay here for a long time."
The two got out of the car and walked towards the main entrance.
If it looks like a prison on the outside, the process of entering is even more like it.
It was time to go to school, and there was a long queue at the door. When Levi took a closer look, he realized that everyone was going through the security check.
"Dip-!"
A black girl with dreadlocks in the front row was stopped.
"Open the bag!" shouted a large security guard. "You know the rules, Tanisha!"
"Fake! I just brought a curling iron!" The girl named Tanisha cursed and reluctantly dumped the contents of the bag on the table, including a rough-made folding comb.
"What is this?" The security guard picked up the comb, looked at it, and threw it directly into the trash can. "The tip is too sharp, so it will be confiscated."
"That's my comb, you bitch-"
"Next!"
After a simple registration, the two were let into the teaching building.
As soon as he entered the corridor, a scent mixed with the smell of leaves, old mop smell and cheap cologne rushed straight to Tianling Gai.
Most of the lockers on both sides of the corridor were sunken and covered with layers of graffiti. Half of the light tubes on the ceiling were broken, and the other half was flickering feebly, making an annoying hissing sound.
"Let me ask, do you grow leaves on your American campus?" Levi looked around at the curious eyes looking at him, "Do I have to go to this high school?"
The glances around them were curious and surprising. Most of the glances came from some Hispanic and black girls—students from these two groups accounted for the majority of the school's ethnic groups. There were also a small number of looks from male students with malicious intentions.
They spoke Spanish with an accent or street talk mixed with slang, pointed at Levi and Don Quixote, and laughed loudly from time to time.
"No way," muttered Don Quixote, "that's the law of New York State."
The two of them turned around and finally found the administrative office in the corner of the first floor.
When he opened the door and walked in, Levi had a deeper understanding of the end of the 'American education system'.
The desk was filled with unprocessed file boxes and even half-eaten pizza boxes. The receptionist was a middle-aged white woman who looked like she had just woken up. Her chin was stretched out by a very thin necklace, and her buttocks looked as big as a planet.
"What?"
She didn't even raise her eyelids, still staring at the Candy Crush elimination game on the computer screen.
"I am Don Quixote Cervantes...this...Ms. Palmer, this is my nephew Levi, who has just arrived in New York." Don Quixote handed over the prepared documents, "I am here to transfer him to another school."
Ms. Palmer took it slowly., while tapping the keyboard like a sloth, while muttering: "Brooklyn... foreigners... have no past performance records. Take it, here is your class schedule, school starts in one month."
The printer screamed like it was about to fall apart.
She typed out Levi's class schedule without even asking what classes Li Wei was going to take.
